title: Dental PPO Plans Out-of-Network Coinsurance on Prior-Level Corrections
content:
**Rule.** The coinsurance a Dental PPO Plans line reprocessed after it was paid at the coinsurance of the plan held before an upgrade (a reprocessed prior-level line) is figured at follows its network status, and so decides the patient share: a basic-class line from an out-of-network practice is figured at the plan's out-of-network basic percentage; a major-class line from an out-of-network practice is figured at the plan's out-of-network major percentage; any other line is figured at the plan's in-network percentage for its service class.

| | Preventive 750 | Value 1000 | Classic 1250 | Plus 1500 | Premier 2000 | Elite 2500 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Out-of-network basic | 0 | 60 | 70 | 80 | 80 | 90 |
| Out-of-network major | 0 | 0 | 40 | 50 | 50 | 60 |
| In-network basic | 0 | 70 | 80 | 80 | 90 | 90 |
| In-network major | 0 | 0 | 50 | 50 | 60 | 60 |

(percentages)

**Points of judgement.**
- The network status is the one carried over from the replaced decision.
- A PPO in-network or Premier in-network line is "any other line" and takes the in-network figure.
- Hypothetical: a major-class line from an out-of-network practice on Premier 2000 is figured at 50 percent; the same line in network at 60 percent.
